hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && python3 scripts/validate_openspec.py --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}\n'

Stop.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && if python3 scripts/validate_openspec.py --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 scripts/check_openspec_drift.py --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'; else printf '{"decision":"continue","reason":"OpenSpec validation or code-to-spec drift checks failed. Run python3 scripts/validate_openspec.py and python3 scripts/check_openspec_drift.py and resolve all errors before finishing."}\n'; fi
